p.title: v59.97 crash-replay reads its fixed 2026 windows from a frozen closes fixture, not the rolling history
p.symptom: ci-crash-replay-check replayed its fixed 2026 windows (2026-03-27 to 2026-10-15) from public-data/history.json, which keeps a rolling 420 rows. A replay with the history cut to start 2026-03-28 exited 1 ('2026-02~03 2026-03-27: history.json has no close'), so from about May 2027 every release would have failed.
p.root_cause: Fixed-date regression windows were bound to a producer artifact whose length rolls forward, so the passage of time removed the dates the gate needs.
p.fix: architecture/fixtures/crash-replay-2026-closes.json holds the session-dated closes (one array per field, 393 sessions 2025-09-18..2026-10-15, 174 KB, breadth denominators kept as eligible) generated once from history.json at 40d470fb3 through buildCloseSeries with the SOXX daily-close fixture folded in; the gate rebuilds rows from it and no longer reads history.json. No check ran on the most recent live weeks, so no live window remains.
p.violated_rule: A gate on the publish path must not fail a correct product because the calendar moved.
p.prevention: The fixed windows no longer depend on the published history's length; a missing fixture close is reported with a v59.97 label.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-crash-replay-check.mjs exit 0, 24 readings before and after, every --verbose reading line identical to the old gate on today's history (only the SOXX source line and the 3/27 note text changed). Cut history (rows after 2026-03-27): old gate exit 1 'history.json has no close', new gate exit 0 with 24 readings.

changelog: **Crash replay keeps its windows ({P}):** the 2026 crash-replay windows now read a frozen closes fixture instead of the rolling 420-row history, so the gate no longer starts failing every release when March 2026 leaves the history (about May 2027).
note: v59.97: crash-replay fixed windows from a fixture
